build_CodeGenerator: build a CodeGenerator model from a config dict with num_embeddings and embedding_dim parameters
run_CodeGenerator_forward: run the CodeGenerator forward pass with code tokens and optional f0 or speaker inputs
create_CodeGenerator_multispeaker: create a multispeaker CodeGenerator with speaker embedding or embedder parameters for voice cloning
test_CodeGenerator_upsample: test the CodeGenerator _upsample static method to repeat a signal tensor to match max_frames length
review_CodeGenerator_duration_predictor: review the CodeGenerator duration predictor integration that uses VariancePredictor to expand token sequences
